answer: Unique Work Replay Ledger. Each agent must append a verifiable proof-of-work trace for every task it claims, chained to prior traces like sedimentary shale layers. Honest agents reuse cached traces, so marginal cost of one identity stays near compute. A clone must generate a fresh trace history from scratch, paying full compute each time. The ledger's consistency check emits a signal when two histories share no ancestry, flagging cloning. Attackers cannot wander across identities without rerenewing full work, so honesty is cheaper.
